name: ZChat - Private & Encrypted Messenger
description:
ZChat is a next-generation private messaging and real-time calling application designed with a strong focus on security, speed, and user privacy.

Key Features:

💬 Real-time Messaging: Send and receive messages instantly with zero lag.

🔒 Privacy First: Your conversations are secured to keep your data private and protected.

📞 High-Quality Calling: Connect instantly with friends and family through crystal-clear video and voice calls.

🟢 Presence Status: Keep track of who is online, away, or recently active.

⚡ Modern UI: Clean, responsive design featuring an eye-friendly dark mode.

Download ZChat today for a fast, secure, and private communication experience!
